authorized_scope: Record the user's documentary acceptance of the historical consent account, preserve originals/packets, audit the update and supply proposed commit text. No coauthor or institutional approval.

public_changes.change: Six-line additive acceptance/navigation note; all pre-existing text preserved.
New attributable single-author acceptance wrapper for the exact historical account.
New technical audit receipt; does not seal its own hash.

negative_control_method: In-memory copies of the acceptance record were separately altered to set coauthor approval, institutional approval, identity verification, execution authority and release authority true. The boundary validator rejected each; no mutated copy was saved.

preservation.algorithm: SHA-256 over UTF-8 concatenation of case-sensitive PowerShell-sorted absolute_full_path<TAB>length<TAB>uppercase_file_SHA256<LF> records; hidden files included. No participant values parsed.
preservation.exclusions: Only the intentionally modified dossier is excluded from the tracked-file group. Only the new, exact d1-rights-documentary-acceptance-2026-10-24 directory is excluded from the prior-audit-local group.
preservation.original_account_checklist_and_preparati: Exact reviewed hashes retained; none of the three preparation files was edited.
preservation.scope_limit: Full existing tracked and prior audit-local file sets were rehashed. External restricted originals were not reread or rehashed in this documentary-only acceptance update; no operation wrote to them.

preserved_reporting_issue.type: Audit-output capture, not a document validation failure
preserved_reporting_issue.detail: First validation command exited successfully, but a Git LF/CRLF warning prefixed captured JSON and the orchestration JSON parser refused it.
preserved_reporting_issue.resolution: Repeated the validation with per-command core.safecrlf=false and explicitly selected the JSON result line; all 20 checks and five negative controls passed. No Git configuration was changed.

unchanged_records: All 24 response forms (only the existing D1_population documentary response is populated)
workflow_state.json and all other tracked workflow-state files
D1_population accepted account and acceptance records
The original 24-item unmarked consent checklist and blank reviewer fields
no_actions: No analysis, sample or manuscript change
No participant, coauthor, institution or funder contact
No commit, push, cloud synchronization, journal submission or public release
